chunks: And from his sayings (peace be upon him) regarding the Kharijites, when he (peace be upon him) heard their saying: 'No verdict/judgment except for Allah,' he (peace be upon him) said:

key_terms.الْخَوَارِج: Kharijites, a early Islamic sect known for their political rebellion and specific theological slogans
key_terms.لَا حُكْمَ إِلَّا لِلَّهِ: No verdict/judgment except for Allah, the famous slogan of the Kharijites

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Ali say in response to the Kharijites' slogan 'No judgment except for Allah'?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) critiques the Kharijites for their literalist misinterpretation of 'La hukma illa lillah,' arguing that they rejected the necessary human application of divine law (hukm) through the Imams and judges. This historical incident highlights the Shia distinction between the absolute sovereignty of God and the delegated authority of His representatives to implement justice on earth.
